text: Simple. If she were to log on to www.socalphysicsgroup.org/activities/other, click on upcoming events, scroll down to seminars, download the pdf schedule, and look for the seminar on molecular positronium, well then, bippidy- boppidy- boo, our pants are metaphorically on fire.

text: Well, sir, my trousers will not be igniting today. Penny, Penny, Penny, Good morning.

text: Do you have any idea what time it is?

text: Of course I do. My watch is linked to the atomic clock in Boulder, Colorado. It's accurate to one tenth of a second. But as I' m saying this it occurs to me that once again your question may have been rhetorical.

text: Remember how Leonard told you we couldn't come to your performance because we were attending a symposium on molecular positronium?
